---
title: "CEF Cheat Sheet"
---

## Bash

List the files in the current directory, including hidden files:

```bash
ls -la
```

## Git

### Stop tracking a file

Keep the file locally while removing it from Git tracking:

```bash
git rm --cached .vscode/htc_AP.bash
```

### Undo the most recent unpushed commit

Keep the changes staged while moving `HEAD` back one commit:

```bash
git reset --soft HEAD~1
```

### Create and push a tag

```bash
git tag -a v2026.08.21 -m "v2026.08.21"
git push origin --tags
```

### Restore a file from another branch

Restore `smk/readme_eval.md` from a remote branch into the current working tree:

```bash
git restore --source=remotes/origin/64-viirs-prewarp-blocks -- smk/readme_eval.md
```

### List all branches

```bash
git branch -a
```

### Merge without committing

This may fast-forward and therefore create no merge commit:

```bash
git merge --no-commit <branch>
git merge --abort
```

### Cherry-pick a commit

Apply a specific commit to the current branch:

```bash
git cherry-pick 1dd0d9bd9e50e41e6d9d7dfc25326155cbb77800
```

## tmux

### Create or attach to a session

```bash
tmux new -s session_name
tmux attach -t <session-name>
```

### Detach from a session

Press `Ctrl+b`, then `d`.

### List all sessions

```bash
tmux list-sessions
```

### Stop every tmux session on the host

```bash
tmux kill-server
```

### Stop one session

```bash
tmux kill-session -t NFHL_process
```
